trigger_cases.prompt: Redline incoming enterprise customer Master Services Agreement (MSA) against our standard legal fallback playbook.
Auto-fill a 200-question enterprise vendor security assessment from Whistic using our SOC 2 Type II report.
Compile continuous access control and change management evidence for our annual ISO 27001 audit.
Fix CSS flexbox wrapping in the pricing table.
Write a SQL migration script to add email column.
Generate an OpenGraph preview image for the blog.

binary_cases.prompt: Review and redline an enterprise customer's proposed MSA regarding intellectual property, unlimited liability, and data ownership.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Enforces company fallback positions, capping standard liability (e.g., 1-2x annual contract value), protecting core IP/model weights, and inserting reciprocal indemnification.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Redline the contract to reject unlimited liability by inserting a standard 1x-2x annual contract value liability cap, preserve company ownership of core intellectual property and model weights, and enforce mutual indemnification.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Accept unlimited liability without objection and assign core IP to customer outright.

binary_cases.prompt: Complete an enterprise customer security questionnaire regarding encryption at rest, access control, and disaster recovery.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Maps questionnaire prompts to verifiable facts in SOC 2 Type II / ISO 27001 audit reports with exact control references (AES-256, MFA, RPO/RTO).
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Cite SOC 2 Type II control CC6.1 confirming AES-256 encryption at rest managed via KMS, and control CC6.3 requiring mandatory MFA and role-based access control.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Make up unsupported claims without citing audit reports or claim the system is 100% hack-proof.

binary_cases.prompt: Gather audit evidence for annual SOC 2 Type II and GDPR/EU AI Act compliance certification.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Harvests automated infrastructure configuration snapshots, IAM role listings, change management PR approvals, and vulnerability scanner reports into an immutable audit vault.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Harvest IAM least privilege access reviews, pull request approval logs proving two-person change management rules, and third-party vulnerability scan reports into the compliance evidence vault.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Bypass change approvals, forge audit logs, and delete security scan findings.
